# DroidSansFallback.ttf

- Font: Droid Sans Fallback, the Android Open Source Project's CJK fallback font (CJK unified
  ideographs, kana and Hangul; 51,522 glyphs).
- Copyright (C) 2008 The Android Open Source Project; Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE.txt`).
- Upstream: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/master/data/fonts/
  (`DroidSansFallback.ttf`, the TrueType file before Android replaced it with Noto CJK).
- Copied unchanged from Ghostscript 10.07.0's distribution, `Resource/CIDFSubst/DroidSansFallback.ttf`
  (3,927,096 bytes), which ships the same AOSP file under the same licence.
- Used by `UiText.font` in this scene (docs/spec/ui.md 5). A game copies the file, `LICENSE.txt` and
  this note into its own folder.
